name: Methylenedioxybenzylamphetamine
summary: MDBZ, also known as 3,4-methylenedioxy-N-benzylamphetamine or as N-benzyl-MDA, is a chemical compound of the phenethylamine, amphetamine, MDxx, and N-benzylphenethylamine families related to MDA. It is the N-benzyl derivative of MDA.

fact.en: It is MDA with a benzyl group on its nitrogen, one of a long run of N-substituted MDA relatives that Alexander Shulgin described in PiHKAL.
fact.zh: 它就是在 MDA 的氮原子上接苄基，屬於亞歷山大．舒爾金在《PiHKAL》中描述的一長串 N-取代 MDA 親戚之一。
fact.zhHans: 它就是在 MDA 的氮原子上接苄基，属于亚历山大．舒尔金在《PiHKAL》中描述的一长串 N-取代 MDA 亲戚之一。
